articles.title: DeFi hacks shake institutional confidence as risks outpace yields
articles.snippet: Repeated bridge exploits and shrinking yields are making institutions question whether DeFi’s risks still justify the returns, says Symbiotic’s Putiatin.

articles.title: Verus bridge exploiter returns $8.5M after bounty offer
articles.snippet: The hacker behind the Verus bridge exploit returned 75% of the stolen funds as part of a recovery deal negotiated with the protocol days after the incident.

articles.title: NEAR Protocol Jumps 28% on Privacy, AI, and Scaling Upgrades
articles.snippet: NEAR rallied by 45% this week on a series of upgrades positioning it as a potential settlement layer for AI agents and confidential finance.

articles.title: Crypto Exchange Blockchain.com Files for IPO in the US
articles.snippet: Long-running crypto exchange Blockchain.com has confidentially filed to take its business public via the U.S. markets.
